observed_error: RunnerError: could not initialise or resume private host run
cause: The fault helper accepted adapter death or zombie status as permission to resume. The guardian can still hold exclusive run ownership while completing cleanup.
independent_reproduction: Pausing the guardian after provider reaping but before guardian exit preserves the run lock. Immediate resume is correctly rejected; after guardian exit and actual lock availability, one resume succeeds without repeating the recorded invocation.
required_repair: Synchronise on actual run-lock availability, retrying only the lock's busy condition. Preserve fail-closed runtime ownership and do not catch-and-retry RunnerError.
scope: Native arm64 tests and the parallel reusable arm64 gate passed. This recorded standalone container failure still prevents acceptance of the candidate.
